text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"The race between Bono and Biko at the
Sprinters
S. was blazing hot!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Bono was absolutely towering and Biko
looked
so petite, but the way they both
ran their hearts
out really moved me!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"There's nothing like racing. I'm on the
edge of
my seat just thinking about
today's race. Go get
'em!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Everyone left so many nice
comments, and
they're all rooting for
me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I took a little peek outside just a minute
ago, and
I saw how many people came
to cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
My heart just filled with happiness when
I saw the
packed stands! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono and Biko Pegasus's battle
in the
Sprinters S. has been the talk of
the town, and
their rematch has drawn
fans from far and wide.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I'm gonna put my 110% into
this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I nearly forgot, but here,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono rummages around for
something,
then holds out a multi-tiered
box to me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I made lunch for you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inside the box are sushi rolls, rice stuffed
in sweet
tofu skins, rolled omelets,
sausages, salad, fried
shrimp, fried
chicken, and stewed veggies. It's a

veritable rainbow of food!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, my mom and dad
would pack a
big lunch for me when we
had sports day at
school.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I remembered how happy I was when I
ate it and
how much it motivated me to
keep going!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to eat with everyone
before the
race, so we can all get ready
to run our best out
there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hold on, I'll go get Biko!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's just about to take off, but I
hurriedly stop
her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's also the fact that she just
finished a
massive lunch earlier, but I
don't say that part
aloud.
choice_data_list: レース前にたくさん食べるのはよくないから
choice_data_list_en: Eating a lot right before a race isn't a good idea, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Haha! I forgot!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right! Dinner's gonna be so fun
tonight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The beautifully packed lunch which she's
filled to
the brim with food is proof of
just how excited
she is to get out on the
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wrap up the box and pray for her
victory.
